content.short: LemFi is a money app for immigrants to hold multi-currency balances and send low-cost international transfers.
content.description: LemFi, founded in 2020, is an international money app built for immigrants and diaspora communities who need to send money home and manage finances across borders. From a single app, users hold multi-currency balances, open local-style accounts and send fast, low-cost transfers to families and businesses across Africa, Asia, Latin America and other regions from hubs like the UK, Europe and North America. LemFi focuses on the specific problems migrants face, such as expensive remittances, limited banking access and clunky foreign exchange, offering transparent rates and quick payouts to bank accounts and mobile wallets. It works as a financial home for people building lives between countries.
content.meta: LemFi is a money app for immigrants with multi-currency accounts and transfers. Discover LemFi and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
